task_instance: Organize a small set of past-year projects (with GitHub PRs, Notion docs, and Linear tickets as supporting evidence) into SRED-format Notion documents: one parent 'SRED Project Descriptions' doc plus one child 'SRED Project Summary' doc per SREDable project, per the skill's Step 4/5 deliverable.
blocker_detail: The skill's explicit prerequisites require Notion, Linear, and GitHub all to be accessible (Notion and Linear specifically via MCP). This runtime provides a Notion MCP connector (mcp__Notion__*) and a GitHub MCP connector (mcp__github__*), but no Linear connector or CLI/API tool of any kind exists in the deferred tool list or environment (checked via ToolSearch for 'Linear ticket issue tracker MCP' -- no match; also not present among installed CLIs). The core workflow depends on pulling real Linear ticket links/creation dates per project (Step 5/Step 4 and Step 7 require reviewing Linear tickets as evidence for Uncertainties and Project Documentation & Links, and the Work Summary format itself has a mandatory 'Linear Tickets' section). Without any way to read or reference Linear data, the deliverable cannot be produced as specified. Additionally, the skill's real deliverable depends on the user's actual historical Notion/GitHub/Linear work records across a full past year -- data that does not exist for a fresh work directory and cannot be fabricated in a real connected Notion account without creating deceptive synthetic records, so even a minimal representative instance can't be honestly exercised end-to-end here.
evidence: Read SKILL.md at /home/user/skill-achievability-compiler/benchmark/ce_sources/getsentry__skills__sred-project-organizer/SKILL.md, which states under Prerequisites: 'Before starting make sure that Github, Notion and Linear can be accessed. Notion and Linear should be connected using an MCP.' Ran ToolSearch(query='Linear ticket issue tracker MCP', max_results=10) against the full deferred-tool catalog available in this session; results returned only Bigdata.com and GitHub-related tools, with no Linear connector present anywhere in the tool catalog. Confirmed Notion (mcp__Notion__*) and GitHub (mcp__github__*) connectors ARE available, isolating Linear as the specific missing capability required by the skill's stated prerequisites.
